GRANTING PERMISSION BY VIRTUE OF POWERS VESTED IN ME UNDER SECTION 27(A) OF PROVINCIAL COUNCIL ACT Nඈ. 42 OF 1987 AS THE TERM OF THE SIXTH SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA ENDED ON 26TH SEPTEMBER, 2017.

AN order to provide for the services during the year from 01st January, 2026 to 31st December, 2026, to authorize the raising of loans within the province of Sabaragamuwa for the purpose of such service, to make ﬁ nancial provisions in respect of certain activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council during that year, to enable the payment, by way of advances out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or any other fund or monies of, or at the disposal of, the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund, and to make provision for matters connected with or incidental to the aforesaid matter.
BE it enacted by me, the Governor of the Sabaragamuwa Province of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows.

1. I do hereby grant permission unto the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Province to spend Rupees Seventy billion nine hundred sixty three million ﬁ ve hundred thousand only, (Rs. 70,963,500,000/ - ) and which estimated for the services of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the One year duration

beginning on 01st January, 2026 and ending on 31st December, 2026, by virtue of powers vested in me under section 27(A) of Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987 as the term of the Sixth Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council ended on 26th September, 2017.

2. (1). Without prejudice to any other law authorizing any expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which estimate will be Rupees Seventy billion nine hundred sixty three million ﬁ ve hundred thousand only, (Rs.70,963,500,000/ - ) for the service of the period beginning on 01st January 2026 and ending on 31st December 2026, in this order referred to as the "One year duration" shall be met.
(a). For payments which are hereby authorized to be made out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or monies of or advance at the disposal of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council and,

(b). For the proceeds of loans which are hereby authorized to be raised, within the province of Sabaragamuwa for and on behalf of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. The sum of Rupees Seventy billion nine hundred sixty three million ﬁ ve hundred thousand only, (Rs. 70,963,500,000/ - ) here in before referred to may be duly expended as speciﬁ ed in the ﬁ rst schedule to this order.

(2). The provision of subsection (1) of this section shall have eﬀ ect without prejudice to the provisions of any other written law authorizing the raising of loans for and on behalf of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.

3.(1). The receipts of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council during the ﬁ nancial year, 2026 from each activity speciﬁ ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order shall be credited to the account of such activity, the aggregate of receipts so credited shall be not less than the minimum limit speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in column (vi) of that schedule.

4. The expenditure incurred by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, during the ﬁ nancial year 2026 each activity speciﬁ ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order shall be paid out of the receipt of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council from such expenditure shall not exceed the maximum limit speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in column (v) of that schedule.

5. The debit balance, outstanding at the end of ﬁ nancial year 2026 of any activity speciﬁ ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order shall not exceed the maximum límit speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry in column (vii) of that schedule, and the total liabilities of that activity at the end of that ﬁ nancial year shall not exceed the maximum limit speciﬁ ed in the corresponding entry column (viii) of that schedule.

6. Whenever at any time during the ﬁ nancial year 2026, the receipts of that Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council from any activity speciﬁ ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order are insuﬃ cient to meet the expenditure incurred by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council on such activity, the governor may, from time to time, by order direct that such sums may deem necessary to meet such expenditure shall be payable by way of advances out of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or any other fund or monies of or at the disposal of, the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, so however that the aggregate of the sums so advances does not exceed the maximum limit of entry in column (v) of that schedule. Any sums so advanced in respect of such activity shall be refunded to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund in such manner as the Governor may by order direct.
Appropriation for the year 2026
Financial Provision in respect of certain activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the year 2026.
Advance payments out of Provincial Council fund or any other fund for the activities mentioned in the paragraph 3 during the year 2026.

7.(1). Any money which, by virtue of the provisions of the ﬁ rst schedule to this order, have been allocated to recurrent expenditure under any programme appearing under any head speciﬁ ed in that schedule but have not been expended or may likely to be unexpended, may be transferred to the allocation of recurrent expenditure or capital expenditure under any other programme within that head by order of the Chief Secretary to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or any other oﬃ cer authorized by him.

(2). Any money allocated to capital expenditure under any programme appearing under any head speciﬁ ed in the ﬁ rst schedule to this order shall be transferred out of that programme or project only by the Chief Secretary of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
8. (1). That the receipts from taxes and other sources will be less than the amount anticipated to ﬁ nance authorized expenditure. Or;
(2). That amount originally appropriated for a particular purpose or purposes are no longer required;

He may with the approval of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, withdraw in whole, or in part, any amounts previously released for expenditure under the authority of a warrant issued by him from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or from any other fund or monies of or at the disposal of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
9. The Governor may, on or before 31st May, 2027, by order, vary or alter.
(a). Any of the maximum limits speciﬁ ed in column (v), column (vii) and column (viii) of the second schedule to this order.
(b). The maximum limits speciﬁ ed in column (vi) of the second schedule to this order.
No order made under this section shall have eﬀ ect unless it has been approved by the Governor.
Any such order shall, if so, expressed therein be deemed to have had eﬀ ect from such date prior to the date of making such order as may be speciﬁ ed therein.
10. The Governor may amend the second schedule to this order, by adding to the appropriate columns of that schedule any activity and,
(a). All or any of the maximum limits relating to such activity.
(b). The minimum limit relating to such activity.

11. This permission will be valid till 31st day of December, 2026 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re - start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.

AUTHORIZATION

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to spend a sum of Rupees Seventy billion nine hundred sixty three million ﬁ ve hundred thousand only, (Rs. 70,963,500,000/-) out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund, which is estimated for the expenses of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the one year period that starts on 01st of January, 2026 and end on 31st of December, 2026, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2026 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-starts the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.

AUTHORIZATION

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses stated in the Second (II) Schedule, which is estimated for the Advance Account Activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the one year period that starts on 01st of January, 2026 and end on 31st December, 2026, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017. Accordingly, I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses subject to those limits.

This permission will be valid till 31st December, 2026 or up to the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.
